Subject: Redwood discovery recap + Dedicated/VPC next steps

Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from my side and proposed next steps so we keep momentum:

Summary (from our discovery)
- Workload: high-throughput inference for real-time fraud scoring (~10k reqs/min peak).
- Current pain: token-level cost and unpredictable tail latency on shared infra; regulatory requirement to isolate data for certain customers.
- Priority/timing: evaluating solutions now with a target pilot in Q4 and production in Q1.

Why Redwood Dedicated + VPC could fit
- Dedicated GPU capacity with predictable throughput for your peak patterns.
- VPC/private deployment option to satisfy data isolation and KMS/HSM controls.
- Observability for per-route cost/latency so you can optimize unit economics.

Immediate next steps I recommend
1) Schedule a short SE call (30–45m) with Jonas to walk the VPC/networking/KMS details and validate architecture.
2) I'll share a ballpark pricing range and a short proposal for Dedicated capacity + VPC options (month-to-month and 12mo commit).
3) If that looks good, we can run a 4–6 week pilot on reserved capacity to validate latency and cost.

Attached: redwood-vpc-overview.pdf (high-level design + security controls).

Proposed SE slots: Tue 8/31 10:00–10:45 PT, Wed 9/1 11:00–11:45 PT, Thu 9/2 14:00–14:45 PT — do any of these work?

Thanks — happy to adjust based on your timeline.

Best,

Hi Samir — great questions. High-level answers (details/line items on the attached proposal):

Pricing (very rough ballpark given current info)
- Small Dedicated pool (suitable for pilot, lower commit): ~$25k–40k/month.
- Production-sized pool for your peaks with predictable latency: ~$90k–150k/month depending on commit and autoscale options.
(We can tighten after architecture/seq length profiling on the SE call.)

On-prem/air-gapped
- We support two private deployment patterns: 1) customer-managed VPC deployments in cloud regions (most common), and 2) on-prem / air-gapped installs for regulated workloads — the latter is available as an enterprise option (longer lead time and licensing). I'll flag your interest in air-gapped to our Private deployments team.

I've attached a short proposal (FinCloud_MAM_Proposal_v2.pdf) with pricing ranges and recommended pilot scope. If that looks reasonable, let's lock Jonas for a 30–45m SE discussion. My preferred times are still Tue 8/31 10:00 PT or Wed 9/1 11:00 PT — if those are tight, propose alternatives.

Relevant links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/FIN-2026-042 (proposal & deal notes)

Thanks —

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood discovery recap + Dedicated/VPC next steps

Samir — quick technical notes ahead of the SE call so you have context: 
- Networking: we support VPC peering, PrivateLink, and customer-managed NATs; for strict egress restrictions we can broker via a transit gateway.
- Key management: integrate with customer KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) and HSM-backed signing for critical keys.
- Data controls: per-route audit logs and retention policies; we can limit token persistence and provide exportable logs for audits.
- Pilot suggestion: seed a single model variant onto a small Dedicated pool, validate p99 latency and per-token cost under sample workload, then expand.

I've dropped a short technical appendix and sample network diagram here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example-vpc-resources

If you want to include your infra lead on the SE call, happy to do that — we can also provide an agenda so it's an efficient 30–45m session.

Best,
